Condo

2478 NW Savier St - 5

Portland, OR 97210

$2,100

Discover urban living at its finest in this charming ground-floor unit located at 2478 NW Savier St, nestled in Portland's highly sought-after Northwest District. Enjoy unparalleled close distance to bustling boutiques, diverse restaurants, and vibrant cafes, with the natural beauty of Forest Park just moments away. This inviting residence boasts a modern grey exterior complemented by lush landscaping and a private, covered porch entry, providing a welcoming first impression. The convenience of off-street parking at the rear of the building is a significant advantage in this desirable neighborhood, ensuring ease and accessibility.
Step inside to a beautifully updated interior featuring rich dark hardwood floors and crisp white walls throughout, creating a bright and contemporary atmosphere. The open-concept living area flows seamlessly into a modern kitchen, equipped with stainless steel appliances, sleek white countertops, a subway tile backsplash, and ample light wood cabinetry, perfect for both everyday meals and entertaining. The well-appointed bathroom offers a spa-like retreat with a stylish grey tiled shower/tub combo, a chic vanity, and a textured accent wall. A comfortable bedroom, serving as a peaceful primary suite, provides a serene space with generous closet storage. Residents also benefit from convenient shared laundry facilities within the building, completing this exceptional rental opportunity.
